purpose: A long-form legal page template: plain title, last updated line, contents that stay in view, numbered sections and a contact block. Privacy is the first use; Terms, Cookies and Accessibility reuse the same design.

primaryAction.label: none on this page (the header carries the check-up outline)

seo.title: Privacy policy | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: How Alliance AI Partners collects, uses and protects personal data, and the choices you have.

sections.name: Section · Title
sections.job: Name the document plainly and show when it last changed.
sections.desktop: Heading/1 (simple page), Body/LG lead at 640, mono 'Last updated [date]' below, then a 240 Ribbon rule (the page's one ribbon signature).
sections.mobile: Same order at 358; the rule shortens to 120.

content.heading: Privacy policy
content.lead: How Alliance AI Partners collects, uses and protects personal data, and the choices you have.

sections.name: Contents
sections.job: Let a reader jump to any section of a long document.
sections.desktop: Left column 296, sticky while the document scrolls: Heading/4 'On this page', eleven numbered items on a 1px hairline rail, the current item marked with a 2px Partner Navy bar and navy text (nav-link styling, not underlined), then 'Other policies' links to Terms, Cookies and Accessibility.
sections.mobile: Collapses to one disclosure row under the title ('On this page · 11 sections', plus icon, 72 tall). The 'Contents open' state shows the eleven items as 48px rows with the current one marked.

sections.name: Section · Policy
sections.job: Hold the numbered legal sections, with bracketed placeholder text until legal review, and show how tables, lists and links sit inside the text.
sections.desktop: Right column 760 (about 68ch): each section has a mono number, a Heading/3 working title and Body text, separated by hairlines. Section 3 includes a three-column table, section 5 a link to the subprocessor list, section 8 a lettered list, section 9 a link to the cookie policy. Section 11 ends with the contact block card.
sections.mobile: Sections stacked at 358; the table becomes stacked label and value rows.

notes: Legal template, no image slots. Section headings are plain working titles for legal to confirm, and every body is a bracketed '[Legal text to come: ...]' placeholder, never lorem ipsum. The contents list uses nav-link styling (Partner 46, current in Partner Navy with a 2px bar), the one place links are not underlined, as in the header nav; every inline link is underlined. A canvas note frame beside the mobile frame records that Terms (/terms), Cookies (/cookies) and Accessibility (/accessibility) reuse this design.
